title: Real account: this-and-following split and removing a Meet link (unverified on Google)
steps: On a real connected calendar, make a weekly test series with no guests and a Meet link in Google Calendar
In Mail open its third occurrence, change the title, press Save and choose This and following events
In Google Calendar check the first two occurrences keep the old title and the series from the third on has the new one
In Mail open another occurrence, untick Google Meet, Save with This event; check Google Calendar shows no Meet link on it
expected: The old series ends before the third occurrence and a new series with the new title starts there; if the second step fails Mail says to check the calendar and retries nothing. The Meet link is gone from that occurrence. Google documents neither behaviour: report any difference.
